+# Design-token system proposal
+
+Date: 2026-10-22 (Asia/Qyzylorda)  
+Status: proposal for owner review; no new color token or semantic role in this document is approved for flow migration  
+Mode: specification artifact only; no code, theme, component, mock, browser render or accessibility acceptance is produced
+
+## 1. Scope and authority
+
+This draft organizes the confirmed frontend direction into a reviewable primitive → semantic → component token system. It preserves every owner-approved anchor in [the shared frontend contract](00-shared-contract.md) and evaluates proposed additions using the static calculations in [the contrast evidence draft](design-token-contrast-draft.md).
+
+The approved anchors remain exactly:
+
+- `#FFFFFF` page ground and `#F5F5F5` secondary surface;
+- `#E5E5E5` decorative divider;
+- `#171717` primary text and `#666666` secondary text;
+- `#2563EB` primary action and `#DC2626` recording/destructive action;
+- `#000000` media stage.
+
+All other shades, semantic mappings and component-state roles below are **PROPOSED**, even when their static contrast calculation passes. This file does not update `00-shared-contract.md`, authorize a flow migration or establish implementation names.
+
+Both requested design skills inform the proposal: `design-taste-frontend` contributes the worked-in app-screen discipline of quiet chrome, flat surfaces and color used for state/action; `frontend-design` contributes deliberate hierarchy, one coherent type system, visible focus and state feedback that does not rely on decoration. Skill guidance cannot approve product tokens.
+
+## 2. Layering model
+
+1. **Primitive tokens** name raw reusable values such as `blue.700` or `neutral.200`. They carry no component meaning.
+2. **Semantic tokens** name product meaning such as `text.secondary`, `action.primary.hover` or `focus.media`.
+3. **Component roles** consume semantic tokens. A component must not select an arbitrary primitive simply because it looks similar.
+
+This separation prevents the decorative divider from becoming an essential field border, keeps interactive states consistent, and allows a future implementation to change aliases without rewriting product meaning.
+
+## 3. Primitive colors
+
+White `#FFFFFF` and black `#000000` are fixed standalone primitives. The table contains all 33 proposed scale values from the evidence draft.
+
+| Step | Neutral | Blue | Red |
+|---:|---|---|---|
+| 50 | `#FAFAFA` | `#EFF6FF` | `#FEF2F2` |
+| 100 | `#F5F5F5` | `#DBEAFE` | `#FEE2E2` |

+| 900 | `#171717` | `#1E3A8A` | `#7F1D1D` |
+| 950 | `#0A0A0A` | `#172554` | `#450A0A` |
+
+Approved values represented inside the scales are `neutral.100`, `neutral.200`, `neutral.600`, `neutral.900`, `blue.600` and `red.600`. The other 27 scale values are proposals. White and black remain separate approved primitives rather than aliases for scale endpoints.
+
+Relative luminance decreases monotonically from 50 through 950 within each scale. The scales are deliberately enumerated values; monotonic luminance is **not** a claim of perceptual uniformity, equal visual steps or safe arbitrary pairing.

+## 4. Proposed semantic color roles

+| Semantic role | Primitive | Intended use | Status/evidence note |

+## 5. Component and state roles
+
+| Component/state | Required semantic roles | Behavioral requirement |
+|---|---|---|
+| Page and existing panel | `page`, `surface`, `text.primary`, `text.secondary`, `divider.decorative` | Keep surfaces flat. A token does not authorize a new wrapper panel/card. |
+| Text field, select or textarea | `border.control`, `text.primary`, `text.secondary`, `focus.light` | The essential boundary uses `neutral.500`, not the decorative divider. Labels remain visible above fields. |
+| Primary filled button | primary default/hover/pressed + primary foreground | White label throughout. State is also exposed by interaction semantics, never color alone. |
+| Recording/destructive button | destructive default/hover/pressed + destructive foreground | Red remains reserved for recording/destructive meaning. |
+| Link | `link` | Link purpose remains understandable from text/context and visible focus, not blue alone. |
+| Invalid field | `error` plus ordinary field roles | Use an adjacent message and invalid semantics; color is supporting feedback. Preserve the entered value under the flow contract. |
+| Selected item | selected background/foreground | Also expose current/selected semantics and, where needed, text/icon/state shape. |
+| Disabled control | disabled background/foreground | Use a real disabled/inactive state and preserve legibility. Do not apply blanket opacity to the whole component. |
+| Keyboard focus on light UI | `focus.light` | 2px blue-600 ring outside a 2px white gap. The gap separates focus from the component border on approved light grounds. |
+| Keyboard focus in media UI | `focus.media` | 2px blue-400 ring on an opaque black control backing. Do not evaluate the ring against a changing video frame. |
+| Loading | existing page/surface/text roles | State the loading work accessibly. Do not invent progress, use decorative looping attention effects or make color the only indication. |

+Focus styling is additional to hover, selected, invalid and disabled styling; those states never erase keyboard focus. Forced-colors and browser focus behavior require rendered verification before acceptance.

+## 6. Confirmed non-color tokens referenced by this proposal
+
+These values are already approved in the shared contract. They are listed for system completeness, not proposed again.
+
+### Typography
+
+| Role | Confirmed value |
+|---|---|
+| Typeface | Mabry Pro |
+| Body and dialogue | Regular 16px / 24px line height |
+| Supporting caption | Regular 14px / 20px line height |
+| Button and field label | Medium at the existing approved size; this draft adds no size |
+| Page heading, desktop | Medium 32px / 40px line height |
+| Page heading, phone | Medium 24px / 32px line height |
+
+Only Regular and Medium are used. Bold and synthetic Bold are excluded. Font-file availability, browser loading and fallback remain unverified.
+
+### Geometry and spacing
+
+| Role | Confirmed value |
+|---|---|
+| Standard control radius | 8px |
+| Standard control height | 40px desktop; 48px phone |
+| Related elements | 8px gap |
+| Form fields/buttons | 16px gap |
+| Blocks within a screen | 24px gap |
+| Major sections | 32px gap |
+| Existing panel padding | 24px desktop; 16px phone |
+| Page gutters | 32px desktop; 16px phone; separate from panel padding |
+| Responsive boundary | Phone below 768 CSS px; desktop from 768 CSS px |
+| Working-content width | Maximum 1200px |
+| Authentication form width | Maximum 400px where the shared form contract applies |

+The spacing scale does not create panels or decorative cards. Screen-specific geometry not implied by these roles remains flow-owned.
+
+### Motion
+
+- Control-state transitions last at most 150ms.
+- No page-entry animation, parallax, decorative motion, animated recording decoration or looping attention effect.
+- System reduced-motion disables interface transitions.
+- Video playback and time-synchronized audio/playhead movement remain functional.
+- Capture, save acknowledgement and navigation never wait for animation completion.
+

+
+The architecture currently intends to use shadcn UI controls. A future implementation may map approved semantic roles to shadcn-style aliases, for example:
+
+| Future alias intent | Proposed semantic source |
+|---|---|
+| background / foreground | `page` / `text.primary` |
+| card / card foreground | `surface` / `text.primary` |
+| primary / primary foreground | `action.primary.default` / `action.primary.foreground` |
+| destructive / destructive foreground | `action.destructive.default` / `action.destructive.foreground` |
+| muted / muted foreground | `surface` / `text.secondary` |
+| input | `border.control` |
+| ring | `focus.light` |
